items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Oh, no, no, Michael, how are you?

ctx.x: Well, I tell you. Yeah. They would go to Tormannous and go out to Spanish Ford. And places like that, you know. But they didn't, they never, they go around, you know, these dance halls or nothing. They wouldn't let them get there. But they'd go in there places and come back with money. No, no.
Why don't you take your cap off now, will you please, partner? Oh, no, no, Michael, how are you? Well... And, uh, let's see. What else do you want to talk about?

Well, the only thing I don't know now is... I still can't play, I'd like to give them a little chance at launching a horn around there. But, kind of slow, but I think it'll happen. Yeah. I think it'll happen. I got it deep in my mind that it's gonna happen. Well... Some guy gonna call me one time, and I'm gonna surprise him, and... There you go.
